id: title:Gilbert09:use the account just authorized in the source wizard

review.posthog_relevance: Adds OAuth callback handling for LinkedIn and Google Ads integrations, allowing the frontend to identify and populate the correct integration ID from the OAuth redirect, replacing hardcoded or retained values.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F1.H1 adds a URL parameter and its constant, while P1.F3.H2 implements the frontend logic to read this parameter and populate the integration selection. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the OAuth flow, allowing the system to correctly associate the OAuth callback with the intended integration rather than retaining an old or unrelated ID
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the backend OAuth callback handler or the complete end-to-end flow, so the exact point of failure prevented and the full implementation cannot be established. The score is assigned based on the observable frontend implementation and parameter addition, not the complete end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the OAuth callback handler or the backend integration creation, so the complete end-to-end flow and the exact point of failure this change prevents cannot be established. The score cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a URL search parameter named 'integration_id' to the OAuth callback redirect URL, and its corresponding constant and usage.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to identify which integration the OAuth callback created, rather than guessing or retaining an old value.

observations.behavior: Replaces the hardcoded string 'integration_id' with the constant OAUTH_INTEGRATION_ID_PARAM in the OAuth callback URL construction.
observations.posthog_connection: N/A; this hunk is a test, not implementation.

observations.behavior: Adds a function authorizedIntegrationId and a useEffect hook that reads the OAuth callback's integration_id, matches it against available integrations, and sets the form value to that ID, while clearing the param from the URL.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to automatically populate the integration selection with the one created by the OAuth callback, rather than retaining an old or unrelated value.
